name: Claude API

transports.evidence: SDK 0.1.5 HTTP transport; fixture and live results recorded separately

fallback_policy: explicit-selection; never retry a submitted turn automatically
limitations: Text/PDF text input; no image/video perception in this adapter.
Conversation history is application-owned; no native resume.
No tool execution; no automatic retry after submission.
Cancellation checked while reading; stalled network IO may wait until its bounded socket timeout.
